Gibson.verification_basis: The current RCVS Find A Vet practice record identifies Dr Gillian Gibson VMD DipACVIM MRCVS as a Partner and veterinary surgeon at Kriek and Gibson Veterinary Surgery. The practice's current team page states that Gillian completed both her bachelor's and veterinary degrees at the University of Pennsylvania, became a Diplomate of the American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine in 2002, and lists haematology (blood and coagulation) among her principal interests. PubMed PMID 12420832 identifies Gillian R Gibson as a University of Pennsylvania coauthor of the 2002 study 'Use of a hemoglobin-based oxygen-carrying solution in cats: 72 cases (1998-2000)', establishing the HBOC authorship link. No LinkedIn or email route is stored because neither was independently required and verified.
